issue.title: [xCluster] Only one cdc stream is set to `ACTIVE` when setting up xCluster replication

labels.name: kind/enhancement
labels.description: This is an enhancement of an existing feature

repository.name: yugabyte-db
repository.description: YugabyteDB - the cloud native distributed SQL database for mission-critical applications.

issue.body:
Jira Link: [DB-8248](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-8248)
### Description

During initial xCluster setup, only one cdc stream is set to active on the producer. It appears that the consumer master only runs `UpdateCDCStream` for one of the tables under replication. For example, if I create bootstraps for more than one table:

```
$ yb-admin -master_addresses $PRODUCER_MASTERS  bootstrap_cdc_producer 0d4fbe1b9cef481c8d4673851c15b66d,229a1c3df40f43089d982cc4dd7d6261,86ac150e4a1a4b238ba50719161d0183
table id: 0d4fbe1b9cef481c8d4673851c15b66d, CDC bootstrap id: 2cf6c98a8318498e96acf2301cc2eb0d
table id: 229a1c3df40f43089d982cc4dd7d6261, CDC bootstrap id: 50f25cd1c4884402a1081da1e44c83cc
table id: 86ac150e4a1a4b238ba50719161d0183, CDC bootstrap id: 2e91e5fa9bda4563a61f52333933f6ec
```

The producer shows the streams as initiated:

```
$ yugatool xcluster -m $PRODUCER_MASTERS stream_info
            STREAM_ID                           TABLE_ID               TABLE    NAMESPACE   RECORD_TYPE   RECORD_FORMAT     STATE
 2e91e5fa9bda4563a61f52333933f6ec   86ac150e4a1a4b238ba50719161d0183   table2   test        CHANGE        WAL             INITIATED
 50f25cd1c4884402a1081da1e44c83cc   229a1c3df40f43089d982cc4dd7d6261   table0   test        CHANGE        WAL             INITIATED
 2cf6c98a8318498e96acf2301cc2eb0d   0d4fbe1b9cef481c8d4673851c15b66d   table1   test        CHANGE        WAL             INITIATED
```
 
 I run setup_universe_replication on the consumer:
 
```
$ yb-admin -master_addresses $CONSUMER_MASTERS setup_universe_replication 5881ec48-64fd-434f-a094-4f1dd28d1c6c $PRODUCER_MASTERS 0d4fbe1b9cef481c8d4673851c15b66d,229a1c3df40f43089d982cc4dd7d6261,86ac150e4a1a4b238ba50719161d0183 2cf6c98a8318498e96acf2301cc2eb0d,50f25cd1c4884402a1081da1e44c83cc,2e91e5fa9bda4563a61f52333933f6ec
Replication setup successfully
```

Only one of the cdc streams changes its state to `ACTIVE`:

```
$ yugatool xcluster -m $PRODUCER_MASTERS stream_info
            STREAM_ID                           TABLE_ID               TABLE    NAMESPACE   RECORD_TYPE   RECORD_FORMAT     STATE
 2e91e5fa9bda4563a61f52333933f6ec   86ac150e4a1a4b238ba50719161d0183   table2   test        CHANGE        WAL             INITIATED
 50f25cd1c4884402a1081da1e44c83cc   229a1c3df40f43089d982cc4dd7d6261   table0   test        CHANGE        WAL             ACTIVE
 2cf6c98a8318498e96acf2301cc2eb0d   0d4fbe1b9cef481c8d4673851c15b66d   table1   test        CHANGE        WAL             INITIATED
```
